[Issue #8995] Add saved opportunities notifications endpoint (#9114)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes #8995  

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Add `GET /<user_id>/saved-opportunities/notifications` returning
notification preferences for a user's saved opportunities
Service layer queries `UserSavedOpportunityNotification` and applies
business logic defaults: `email_enabled=True`, org-scoped settings
default to `email_enabled=False`
Organization settings are only returned for orgs where the user has
`VIEW_ORG_SAVED_OPPORTUNITIES` privilege

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
The response shape is:

```json
{
  "self": { "email_enabled": true },
  "organizations": [{ "organization_id": "...", "email_enabled": false }]
}
```
`self` is always present even with no DB row. Organization entries only
appear for orgs the user can access.

## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
See updated unit tests.
